description:
Smart. Focused. Email.

Fast, cross-platform email designed to filter out the noise - so you can focus on what's important.
In this update:
- Refreshed the Auto-Drafts feedback panel with a cleaner, more consistent design.
- Fixed an issue where Auto-Drafts could say an email was cut off and ask the sender to resend it, even though the full message had arrived.
- Fixed an issue where Spark could crash when switching back to the app.

New to Auto-Drafts?
Spark drafts replies in your voice before you even open the email. Review, tweak, or send with one click. Nothing goes out without you.
Available across all accounts with Spark Pro.
We're always here for you at support@sparkmailapp.com

P.S. If you encounter any issues with the automatic update, please use the following link to download the update manually:
https://downloads.sparkmailapp.com/Spark3/win/dist/3.31.4.141104/Spark.exe
